data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 's-b-t', meaning to be steadfast, firm, unwavering. Masbat is a name that evokes strength, determination, and resilience. It is a name for those who face challenges with unwavering resolve, and who embody the steadfastness and reliability of a strong animal or mountain. The name Masbat carries the meaning “Steadfast, firm, unwavering” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Masbat usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast, firm, unwavering and live with faith, good character and purpose.
